errors.text: The proposed silicide surface modification is absent from the target study and is not supported by either cited evidence record.
The hypothesis does not identify the FeNiCrCoCu coating/Cu substrate system or the target nanoindentation and friction protocol.
Temperature, load, sliding speed, coating composition, and silicide chemistry are left unspecified, so the claimed operating range is not testable as written.
The proposed protective-oxide mechanism does not match the target mechanism involving temperature-dependent lattice disorder, HCP fraction, dislocation density, hardness, modulus, and friction.
The prediction omits the critical approximately 900 K transition and the sharp deterioration in hardness and wear resistance above that threshold.
